title: class_changed
description: The facts the message kind class_changed (something changed for your class: date, time, length, place, room, lead instructor or notes) can use. A fact schema is the one definition of what a template of this kind may mention: the Console offers exactly these as placeholders and the checker refuses any other. Facts marked x_derived are worked out by the kind's fact builder in the product, not typed by anyone and not computed by the template.

x_kind.name: Class changed (something changed for your class)
triggers: A class that is scheduled or enrolling, has a start time and has not started yet is saved with a different start, time zone, length, venue, room or venue notes (automatic). One message per person per save.
The lead instructor of such a class changes: a new lead is placed, a role changes, or the lead leaves (automatic).
A venue's name, or the place a venue is at (moved, or its address or name edited), changes for every such class at that venue (automatic).
x_kind.recipient: individual: every person with an open placement (assigned, confirmed or waitlisted; students and instructors) in the class. A waitlisted student gets the message without a calendar file.
x_kind.dedupe: explicit key: kind + person + attendance id + the updated_at of the save that caused the change

name.description: How the email greets the person: their given name, else their display name, else the word there.

start_utc.description: When the class starts (UTC, to the second). Used for the calendar file.

end_utc.description: When the class ends (UTC). Start plus the duration, 60 minutes if none is set. Used for the calendar file.

time_zone.description: The class's time zone as an IANA name; America/Denver if none is set. An unknown name shows times in UTC.

when_day.description: The day in words, in the class's time zone.

when_span.description: The start and end times with the zone abbreviation, in the class's time zone.

when_short.description: A short day and start time for subject lines.

uid.description: The id the calendar file uses to recognize the event, so the update replaces the event the placement email added. The attendance record's id. Absent for a person on the waiting list, who has no calendar event: the calendar file is then not attached.

venue.description: The venue's name. Absent when none.

room.description: The room label at the venue. Absent when none.

where.description: Venue and room together, joined with a middle dot. Absent when both are absent.
examples: Ozo's Coffee, East Pearl · Back room

address.description: The venue's address on one line. Absent when none.

map_url.description: A map search link for the venue and address. Absent when there is neither.

summary.description: One sentence saying what changed, in plain words, built from the changes (for example: The date and time and the room changed.).
examples: The date and time and the room changed.

change_when.description: Shown only when the day, time or length changed: the old day and times, an arrow, then the new ones.
examples: Wednesday, October 21, 2026, 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM MDT → Thursday, October 22, 2026, 9:00 AM to 10:30 AM MDT

change_where.description: Shown only when the venue changed or the venue's name or place changed: the old venue and address, an arrow, then the new.
examples: Ozo's Coffee, 1500 Pearl St → Amante North, 4580 Broadway, Boulder, CO 80344

change_room.description: Shown only when the room changed: the old room, an arrow, then the new (a missing room reads none).

change_lead.description: Shown only when the lead instructor changed: the old name, an arrow, then the new (a missing lead reads none).

change_notes.description: Shown only when the venue notes of the class changed: the old notes, an arrow, then the new.
examples: Park behind the building → Park in the lot

notes.description: The class's current venue notes. Absent when none.

waitlist_note.description: Said only to a person on the waiting list: that they are still on it. Absent for everyone else.
examples: You are still on the waiting list for this class.
